name: Flowing Water Style (Combat, Style)
body:
You move with fluid grace, each movement providing few vulnerabilities to exploit, like a pool of clear water.

Prerequisite(s): Wis 15, Improved Unarmed Strike, BAB +1

Benefit(s): When you fight defensively or use the combat expertise feat while unarmed, you gain an additional +1 dodge bonus to AC. When you take a full defense action while unarmed, you gain a +2 dodge bonus to AC.

Special: This feat is added to the list of feats that a monk may select as a bonus feat at 1st level and above. A martialist may treat his Int score as his Wis score for the purposes of selecting this feat.
